verdict.rationale: Pulumi defines infrastructure automations as code, with Pulumi-maintained GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps integrations for versioning. Review is supported through `pulumi preview`, which shows changes without applying them, and policy violations now appear in pull request comments and checks. However, nothing in the evidence documents a rollback capability; the REST API only mentions access to state history. Missing for 10: documented rollback or revert of stacks/deployments, explicit stack history/versioning workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the version-review-rollback loop.
